verse.verse_1: When the earth will be shaken with a mighty shaking,
verse.verse_2: and the earth will throw up all her burdens,
verse.verse_3: and man will cry out: “What is the matter with her?”
verse.verse_4: On that Day it will relate all her news,
verse.verse_5: for your Lord will have commanded her (to do so).
verse.verse_6: On that Day people will go forth in varying states so that they be shown their deeds.
verse.verse_7: So, whoever does an atom's weight of good shall see it;
verse.verse_8: and whoever does an atom's weight of evil shall see it.
